content: Samuel, Saúlʼse ulusad
Saúl sapinseredgine, Israel-yargi reyga megnonikid. Birga-dulabo-gakabo (42) reyga-maigusad.

Saúl, Israel-dulemar-abargi milipaa (3,000) sordamar-susad. We-sordamar-sulesadi, Saúlʼba Micmasʼgi, degi, Betel-yargine milibo (2,000) ambikusad. E-machi-Jonatánʼbardi Benjamín-neggwebur Gabaaʼye-nugadgi miligwen (1,000) ambikusmogad. Saúl Israel-dulemar-bamaladdi e-neg-e-negse barmisad.

Jonatán, Filistea-sordamar-Guebaʼgi-bukwad obelosad. We-ibmar-gusad Filistea-dulemar-bamalad wisgusmalad. Geb degine, Saúl bela Israel-yargi gar-trompeta-ogolega imaksad, ar sogded: “¡Bela Hebreo-dulemar we-ibmar-gusad wisguergebed!”

Bela Israel-dulemar we-gayaburba wisgusmalad: “Saúl, Filistea-sordamar-Guibeaʼgi-bukwad-obelosye. A-ulale, Filistea-dulemar isdar Israel-dulemar-dake gunonimarsunnad.” Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar bila-onogega Gilgalʼgi Saúlʼba atosmalad.
Filistea-sordamar, Israel-sordamargi-bila-onogega na atosmarmogad.
Israel-sordamar, Filistea-sordamar-doggus-merguedba, na boni-dummad-amis dakarmalad. Degisoggu, bela Israel-sordamar bergue-itoarmaladba,
Hebreo-dulemar gwenna-gwenna Gad-yarse, degi, Galaad-yarse wakinmalaga Jordán-diwar obaksamalad. Saúlʼdi, Gilgalʼgi besad. Geb bela sordamar-eba-besmalad na dobedba wawanmakbukwad.
Ar Saúl, Samuel ega iba-mesisadbali, ibagugle (7) abitosad. Ar Gilgalʼgi Samuelʼdi yogguded. Geb Saúl e-sordamar-wakinmamai dakargua,
igar-ukded: “Ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged, degi, gwenatigwar-guega-ibmar-ukleged be anga sedamala.” Geb Saúlʼsunnad ibdurgan-ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga uksad.
Saúl ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged-uknaid bergusayala, Samuel nonikid. Saúl, Samuel-abin naded, geb doggus-nued-sogeye ega sogded.

Ar Samuelʼdi, sabsur ega ibmar-sogded: —¿Ibiga be yogasaar ibmar-imaksa? Bab-Jehováʼgi be dummad-nosad. Saúl abin-sogded: —Ar an-sordamar wakinmamai an dakalid, be iba-mesisadba gwen be nonisuli an be-dakarbalid, degine, Micmasʼgi, Filistea-sordamar bato guagwar-bukwa an dakarbalid. A-ulale, weyob an binsaded:
‘Filistea-dulemar Gilgalʼse bato angi bila-onodasokarmalad, degi-inigwele, andi amba yoo Bab-Jehováʼse bendakleged egised. A-ulale, ibdurgan-ogumakar-ukleged an uke daklearsunnad.’
Samuel, Saúlʼga sogded: —¡Be binsaed-satedsi weyob be ibmar-imaksagu! Ar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bega igar-uksadba be ibmar-imaksana, be-wagan Israel-yargi degisadegu reymarga-megmai gumaloenad.
Emigindi, an bega sogsundo, ar bedi Bab-Jehová-igar-maidba ibmar-imaksasursoggu, reyga-be-maid gadeguosulid. Bab-Jehováʼdi dule-eba-daoed bato amisad.

Samuel weyob ibmar-sogsagua, Gilgalʼgi-gudiidgi naded. Dule-bamaladdi, Gilgal-akale Saúlʼba, Benjamín-neggwebur-Gabaaʼye-nugadse, e-sordamar-bukwadse nadmarmogad. Agi, Saúl, sordamar-eba-gudimalad ebichisad, amardi dulataled-ilanergwa (600) mergued.
Jonatán Filistea-dulemarbo bila-onosad
Saúl na e-machi-Jonatán, degi, e-sordaganmala, Benjamín-neggwebur-Gabaaʼye-nugadgi ambikusmalad. Deunni, Filistea-sordamardi, amba Micmasʼgi bukwamalad.
Filistea-sordamar bukwamaladgi, sogapaa danar-danar e-sordamar ainiarmalad: Soggwendi, Ofra-igarba Sual-yarsik nadmalad.
Baiddi, Bet-Horónʼsik nadmalad. Sogapaagwaddi, yar-abingunaidsik nadmarmogad. A-yar-abingunaidgi, Zeboim-neba nega-dulesulidgansik magar-dakleged.
Ar Filistea-dulemar mer Hebreo-dulemar es-suid-sobega, degi, mer eswar-sobbaliga imaksamalad. Degisoggu, bela Israel-yargine dule-esgoro-sobed wargwensaar sated.
Degisoggu, bela Israel-dulemar, akan, napa-imued, napa-akwied, degi, es-dopegwad nugar-onikuega Filistea-dulemarse naddamalad.
Ar akan, degi, es-dopegwad, nugar-onikuega mani-gargerba bennukdamalad. Napa-imueddi, napa-akwieddi, nugar-onikuega bur mani-gargerba bennukdamalad.
Degisoggu, unnila Saúl, Jonatán-ebo es-suid, degi, eswar nikamalad. Israel-sordamardi wargwensaale, es-suid, degi, eswar satemalad.
Filistea-sordamar-danar-soggwenad Micmas-igarse bukunonimalad.
